Behind the image
39 / Gilded Jewel
REFERENCE 5796.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 030
Art direction: Haute couture opulence, antique gold and jet black, glittering bokeh, regal profile.
Photorealistic vertical haute couture beauty portrait in profile of an original adult woman with dark
brown hair in a low, softly undone chignon with a center part and loose face-framing strands, pale
blue eyes with soft shimmer and peach-coral lips. She wears a sheer tulle neckline over a
gold-embroidered metallic bodice, a draped jeweled choker and large chandelier earrings with
black stones and pearls. Glittering gold bokeh background, antique gold and jet-black palette,
regal mood, no text or logos.
40 / Eyelet Blue
REFERENCE 5795.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 031
Art direction: Cool pale blue backdrop, glossy skin and hair, minimal futuristic detailing.
Photorealistic vertical beauty portrait of an original adult woman with wet-look dark brown hair
swept to one side and a single loose strand across her face, graphic black liner on pale gray-green
eyes and glossy peach lips. She wears a navy high-neck knit with copper eyelets and fine stitched
line details. Soft sky-blue gradient background, glossy skin, minimal futuristic styling, cool pale
palette, no text or logos.
